atoms.sound: To get to school every morning, my parents drive me to the station to catch the train. I ride the train for half an hour, then I meet my friends and we get a bus the rest of the way.
For our summer holidays, we usually fly to Spain on a plane. While we are there, we rent bikes to ride around the city. Sometimes, we even take a trip on a boat!
